summary:
All 14 acceptance criteria are met on this tree, and every one was checked by running something, not by reading the code. The strongest contact is `code`: I ran the project's own scripts and tests, plus the harness against the live TAAD engine checkout (taad_v3 72bfcb4, clean) on real NTFS. None of that is a user-facing environment.

**What I re-ran**
- **Parity on the real tree:** `rules-parity.ps1` reads AGREE (7 facts from 10 twinned entries, 21 patterns, 7 settled entries), exit 0, under powershell.exe 5.1.26100 and pwsh 7.6.6. It gives the same result from a fresh `git clone` of slice/SL-031.
- **The rule cases:** `RuleCases.ps1 -Case All` against the real engine: C-001 to C-014, 415 ok, 0 FAIL, 205 s.
- **Full harness:** `--scenario all` twice gave byte-identical 32-row matrices, all AS-RECORDED, exit 0. A third run with `--root` on the fresh clone gave the same 32/32.
- **Core.Tests:** 120/120.
- **The wiring actually bites:** in the clone, a yaml typo makes `dotnet test --filter RuleCopiesAgreeTests` fail, with the DRIFT report in the assertion message. Reverted, the clone passes 8/8 (RuleCopiesAgree plus the 7 ArchitectureRules Facts).

**My own probes, beyond the builder's cases**
- 11 drift shapes (edits in one copy, (?m) and BOM-guard edge cases, a twin moved below the settled marker) each gave DRIFT, exit 1, in both shells.
- 6 unreadable shapes (double-quoted, block and flow yaml, tab indent, a non-verbatim C# literal, `[Fact]` removed) each gave CANNOT-READ, exit 2.
- 4 correct-agree shapes (reordered patterns, a renamed Fact, `""` and `''` quote decoding) read AGREE, which is right.
- One genuine divergence row (D6) re-encoded as UTF-8 gave DIVERGENCE-CLOSED, exit 1.
- The scratch folder in %TEMP% keeps a case-only rename on this NTFS volume (case-sensitive attribute disabled).

**Numbers that differ from the criterion text**
- Criterion 1 says 4 settled entries; the tree has 7. That is the original 4 plus the 3 rules this slice's own design appended under `# settled by SL-031`. Parity reports 7, and the harness checks Fitness's 17 rules = 10 twinned + 7 settled.

**Blind spots, all outside the criteria**
On temp copies, parity reads AGREE over four yaml changes that do alter what Fitness enforces:
- `including_comments` flipped to false;
- a duplicate twinned entry with a wider `files` scope, which content pairing accepts;
- a `files` scope narrowed;
- an `except_files` entry dropped.

The design limits parity to patterns and leaves scope and exemptions to the harness. The harness catches only the scope and exemption changes that some plant or the clean baseline happens to exercise. The comment flag and the duplicate entry are not in any criterion, so they are recorded here, not filed.

**Loop observed in the index:** build attempts 2 to 5 were each sent back by code-review for the same class of defect, a spelling that `rules-parity.ps1` neither read nor refused. Each changed only that script and `RuleCases.ps1`. They did change src, so this is not the no-src loop shape. Attempt 5 swapped the refusal lists for closed grammars, and code-review 5 and my probes found no further shape.

Nothing I ran left files in the repo: `git status` is unchanged and my temp folders are deleted.

checks.what: Engine Fitness check on the worktree (the declared architecture rules, including the 3 SL-031 appended)
checks.evidence: 17 rule(s) checked against 43 file(s) read. Every declared rule holds.

checks.what: Parity on the real tree under both shells, with the reflected count
checks.evidence: Both shells print 'rules-parity: AGREE 7 facts <- 10 twinned entries, 21 patterns; 7 settled entries not compared', exit 0.

checks.what: Parity refuses a Fact count that differs from the reflected count
checks.evidence: CANNOT-READ ...ArchitectureRulesTests.cs: the reader found 7 Facts where the test class has 8. Exit 2.

checks.what: Parity from a fresh clone of slice/SL-031, and from an unrelated working directory
checks.command: git clone --branch slice/SL-031 <worktree> %TEMP%\sl031-validate\clone; powershell.exe -File clone\eng\rules-parity.ps1 [-Root clone] -ExpectFacts 7
checks.evidence: The clone is at 867092c. Parity reads AGREE, exit 0, both with -Root and with cwd=%TEMP% using the script-relative default.

checks.what: Every rule case, run against the real engine
checks.evidence: Exit 0 in 205 s: 415 'ok', 0 'FAIL', 'All checks held.' C-006 to C-014 each ran the real harness: F01-F16 AS-RECORDED; the per-scope deletion bites gave MISSED-BY-FITNESS and MISSED-BY-XUNIT; P07c-e AS-RECORDED; the FIRED-WHEN-EXEMPT bite fired; D1-D7, D9-D11 and D13 AS-RECORDED; the rename-to-same-name bite gave PLANT-BROKEN; C-014 gave DIVERGENCE-CLOSED.

checks.what: Independent drift probes: an edit in one copy only
checks.command: %TEMP%\sl031-validate\probes.ps1 (temp copies of the two files, both shells): A C# narrowed, B extra yaml pattern, L case-only yaml change, M (?i) added, N trailing space, S yaml '' vs C# "", U C# escape dropped
checks.evidence: Each gave 'rules-parity: DRIFT 2 unpaired' and exit 1 under powershell.exe and pwsh, naming the Fact and the yaml entry with file:line and the differing pattern text.

checks.what: Independent unreadable-shape probes
checks.command: probes.ps1: E double-quoted pattern, F block scalar >-, G flow sequence, H non-verbatim C# literal, O tab indent, K [Fact] removed with -ExpectFacts 6
checks.evidence: Each gave CANNOT-READ at its own file:line, exit 2, in both shells. Examples: '.taad/fitness.yaml:125: ... is a double-quoted scalar', '...:172: must_not_match ... is not a block list', 'ArchitectureRulesTests.cs:45: ... not one verbatim @"..." literal'.

checks.what: Independent correct-agree probes
checks.command: probes.ps1: C yaml patterns reordered, I Fact method renamed, Q C# @"File""X" against yaml 'File"X', R C# @"File'X" against yaml 'File''X'
checks.evidence: Each read AGREE, exit 0, in both shells. Order and names do not matter, and quote decoding matches on both sides.

checks.what: Independent normalisation edge probes
checks.command: temp copies: ﻿? not after ^; ^﻿? added where C# has no ^; (?m)(?m); (?m) mid-pattern
checks.evidence: All four gave DRIFT, exit 1, in both shells. The mid-pattern case is annotated '(lacks (?m))'.

checks.what: Independent probe: a twinned entry moved below the settled marker
checks.evidence: 'DRIFT 1 unpaired (7 facts, 9 twinned entries...)': Fact TheScannerMakesNoBclFileSystemCalls pairs with no twinned entry. Exit 1.

checks.what: Parity blind spots outside the criteria: yaml changes that alter what Fitness enforces
checks.command: probes.ps1: J files scope narrowed, V including_comments: false, W except_files entry dropped, T duplicate one-scope twinned entry (wider scope) above the marker
checks.evidence: All four read AGREE, exit 0; T reports 11 twinned entries. The design scopes parity to patterns, and the harness covers scope and exemptions only where a plant or the clean baseline exercises them (C-008 and C-009 bites). None of the 14 criteria names these shapes, so this is recorded as a limit, not a criterion failure.

checks.what: End-to-end gate: RuleCopiesAgreeTests fails `dotnet test` on drift
checks.command: in the clone: yaml '(?m)(Library|Dll)Import' -> '...Imprt'; pwsh -File <worktree>\eng\dotnet.ps1 test tests/FsAnalyser.Core.Tests/... --filter FullyQualifiedName~RuleCopiesAgreeTests
checks.evidence: Failed: 1. The message reads 'eng/rules-parity.ps1 exited 1 (1 DRIFT, 2 CANNOT-READ) for 7 Facts: rules-parity: DRIFT 3 unpaired ...' and names both Interop entries and the Fact. Exit 1.

checks.what: The clean clone is green under both copies of the rules
checks.evidence: Passed 8, Failed 0. Exit 0.

checks.what: Full harness run 1 (clean, plants and divergences)
checks.evidence: Clean baseline: xunit 7 Facts, 0 hits; fitness pass, 17 rules, 43 files read, 0 hits, CLEAN. Then '32 rows, 32 AS-RECORDED, 0 not, 0 stray hits', exit 0, 13 s. D8 and D12 are included; D12's recorded line offsets hold.

checks.what: Full harness run 2 gives the same result as run 1 (O-001)
checks.command: same command again; Compare-Object on the two outputs, excluding the scratch-path/time line
checks.evidence: 40 lines each, IDENTICAL, both exit 0.

checks.what: Full harness against the fresh clone
checks.evidence: 32 rows, 32 AS-RECORDED, 0 stray, exit 0. The clone's git status was empty before and after.

checks.what: Closure of a genuine divergence row is caught by exit code (O-003)
checks.command: temp divergences.json with D6 encoding utf16le -> utf8; harness.py --scenario divergences --only D6 --divergences <temp>
checks.evidence: 'D6 divergences 1 fire/fire quiet/fire DIVERGENCE-CLOSED: both engines now give (fire): delete row D6 ...', exit 1. I deleted the kept scratch afterwards.

checks.what: The scratch filesystem keeps a case-only rename (O-002)
checks.command: in %TEMP%: Rename-Item EntryClassifier.cs -> Entryclassifier.cs, then a two-step rename back; fsutil file queryCaseSensitiveInfo; Get-Volume C
checks.evidence: The listing shows 'Entryclassifier.cs', then 'EntryClassifier.cs'. C: is NTFS and the case-sensitive attribute is disabled. harness.py:438-442 asserts the listing shows the new name and not the old, and D3, D4 and D9 were never PLANT-BROKEN across 4 runs.

checks.what: Full Core.Tests suite
checks.evidence: Passed 120, Failed 0, Skipped 0.

checks.what: No machine-specific path in eng/ beyond documentation text
checks.evidence: The only hits are docstring or help text in harness.py:10, 16 and 104 ('<taad_v3 checkout>', '%APPDATA%', '~/.claude'). None is a path the code uses.

checks.what: Nothing I ran left files behind
checks.evidence: git status is the same as at start (only index.json and the two .taad detail files). There are no fsa-rules-* or fsa-parity-case-* folders, and my own sl031-validate folder was removed.

checks.what: The C# name-resolution limit the builder declared (a type named Regex, or a global using alias, in another file)
checks.evidence: Not probed. The builder and code-review already record it as a known limit that only the behavioural harness would see, and no criterion names it.

criteria.criterion: 1. Rule copies agree on the clean tree: 7 Facts, 10 twinned yaml entries, 21 patterns, settled entries below the marker
criteria.how: Parity reads 'AGREE 7 facts <- 10 twinned entries, 21 patterns; 7 settled entries', exit 0, under powershell.exe 5.1 and pwsh 7, with and without -ExpectFacts 7, in the worktree and a fresh clone. The criterion text says 4 settled; the tree has 7 because this slice's design appended 3 rules under '# settled by SL-031'. The harness confirms Fitness loads 17 = 10 + 7.

criteria.criterion: 2. A pattern edited or dropped in only one copy is caught
criteria.how: C-002 passed. My own probes (C# narrowed, extra yaml pattern, case-only change, (?i) added, trailing space, quote mismatch, dropped escape) each gave DRIFT, exit 1, in both shells. End to end, a yaml typo in a fresh clone fails `dotnet test` through RuleCopiesAgreeTests.

criteria.criterion: 3. A Fact with no yaml entry, or a yaml entry above the settled marker with no Fact, is caught
criteria.how: C-003 passed: twin deleted; split Fact changed; new entry above the marker DRIFT; the same entry below the marker AGREE. My probe moving a twin below the marker gave DRIFT (Fact unpaired). Limit: an exact duplicate of an existing twin's patterns above the marker content-pairs and reads AGREE.

criteria.criterion: 4. Patterns are normalised before comparing: missing (?m); BOM guard as ﻿ in any case or a literal U+FEFF
criteria.how: C-004 passed: missing (?m) gives DRIFT '(lacks (?m))'; four guard spellings read AGREE; the guard without '?' gives DRIFT. My edge probes (guard not after ^, ^guard where C# has no ^, doubled (?m), (?m) mid-pattern) all gave DRIFT.

criteria.criterion: 5. Shapes the reader cannot classify or count exit 2 (two literals per line, concatenation, raw string, const, nameof, Fact without AssertNoMatch or with zero patterns, double-quoted or block yaml, zero Facts, count mismatch)
criteria.how: C-005 (230 checks in my All run) passed. My probes (double-quoted, block scalar, flow list, tab indent, non-verbatim literal, [Fact] removed) and -ExpectFacts 8 each gave CANNOT-READ with file:line, exit 2.

criteria.criterion: 6. Harness resolves the TAAD engine: missing or wrong root, or a result lacking a field, exits 2
criteria.how: C-006 passed. A nonexistent root, the repo as root, no --engine-root, a fake engine whose result lacks 'unran', and a broken import each exit 2, naming the path. TAAD3_HOME is pointed at scratch before the import. Never reported as a disagreement.

criteria.criterion: 7. Harness clean scenario, with no plants applied
criteria.how: C-007 and my two full runs: xunit 7 Facts, 0 hits; fitness pass, 17 rules, 43 files, none unmatched or unran; CLEAN. Bite: a stray DllImport in the tree gives exit 2 'the clean baseline is not clean'.

criteria.criterion: 8. 16 must-fire plants, one per scope of each split Fact, insert-after rows landing in files that have lines
criteria.how: F01-F16 AS-RECORDED in C-008 and in my two full runs plus the clone run. Per scope: screen *.cs (F01, F14-F16) and *.csproj (F04, F05); reparse *.cs (F07, F08, F13) and *.xaml (F06); interop src (F02) and tests (F12). The insert-after anchors are in existing files. Bites: a scope deleted from yaml gives F12 MISSED-BY-FITNESS; the same scope dropped from C# gives MISSED-BY-XUNIT.

criteria.criterion: 9. Plants in exempted files (P07c-e) stay quiet
criteria.how: P07c-e quiet/quiet AS-RECORDED in C-009 and my full runs. Bites: P07d moved to DirectoryReader.cs gives FIRED-WHEN-EXEMPT, exit 1; the EntryClassifier exemption dropped from yaml fails the clean baseline, exit 2.

criteria.criterion: 10. A violating file under packages/ or dist/ (D1, D2)
criteria.how: D1 and D2 xunit fire, fitness quiet, AS-RECORDED in C-010 and 3 full runs. D8 (target/) is also AS-RECORDED.

criteria.criterion: 11. UTF-16LE, cp1252 and over-2-MB files carrying a violation
criteria.how: D6 and D11 (UTF-16LE), D7 and D10 (over 2 MB): xunit fire, fitness quiet. D13 (cp1252): both fire. All AS-RECORDED in C-011 and 3 full runs.

criteria.criterion: 12. Case-only rename of an exempted file, two-step through a temp name on NTFS
criteria.how: D3 (Entryclassifier.cs), D4 (testNative.cs) and D9 (Testnative.cs) xunit fire, fitness quiet, AS-RECORDED. The harness asserts the listing change (harness.py:438-442). The bite (rename to the same name) gives PLANT-BROKEN. My own probe confirms %TEMP% on NTFS keeps the case.

criteria.criterion: 13. A using directive split across two lines (D5)
criteria.how: D5 xunit quiet, fitness fire, AS-RECORDED in C-013 and 3 full runs.

criteria.criterion: 14. A recorded divergence both engines now agree on fails
criteria.how: C-014 (D13 recorded as a split) gives DIVERGENCE-CLOSED, exit 1. My independent run with genuine divergence D6 re-encoded as UTF-8 gives DIVERGENCE-CLOSED, exit 1, with the 'delete row D6 ...' instruction.

obligations.evidence: Two full `harness.py --scenario all` runs against the real engine gave identical 40-line outputs (32 rows, all AS-RECORDED, including every divergence row D1-D13), ignoring only the scratch-path/time line. A third run on a fresh clone and the RuleCases subset runs gave the same verdicts for every row they covered.

C: is NTFS and the %TEMP% directory's case-sensitive attribute is disabled (fsutil). A one-step and a two-step case-only rename in %TEMP% both show the new case in the listing. harness.py:438-442 marks a row PLANT-BROKEN unless the listing shows `to` and not the old name. D3, D4 and D9 read AS-RECORDED, never PLANT-BROKEN, in 4 runs; the same-name bite does give PLANT-BROKEN.

C-014 (D13 recorded as fitness quiet) gives DIVERGENCE-CLOSED, exit 1. Independently, genuine divergence D6 re-encoded as UTF-8 in a temp rows file gives 'D6 ... fire/fire quiet/fire DIVERGENCE-CLOSED', exit 1. The exit code catches it, with no human reading the matrix.

not_reached: Any machine other than this one: the harness ran only against this machine's taad_v3 checkout (72bfcb4) and engine venv (%APPDATA%\taad3\venv, Python 3.14.7). A clean clone elsewhere, without the engine, was not tried; by design the harness exits 2 there.

Other shells and SDKs: only Windows PowerShell 5.1.26100 and pwsh 7.6.6 were exercised, on Windows 11 26200. Windows 10 was not tried. Every build used the repo-local .dotnet SDK 10.0.401, never a machine-wide 10.0 SDK.
Future engine versions: every recorded outcome was measured against taad_v3 at 72bfcb4. Whether the rows stay AS-RECORDED as the engine changes is exactly what the harness exists to report later.

Parity blind spots beyond patterns: flipping including_comments, adding a duplicate twinned entry with a wider scope, narrowing a files scope, or dropping an except_files entry all read AGREE. The harness catches scope and exemption changes only where a plant or the clean baseline exercises them. The comment flag on an entry whose plants are code (e.g. F03's rule) and a duplicate entry are seen by neither tool.
The declared C# name-resolution limit (a type named Regex or a global using alias in another file changes AssertNoMatch's meaning) was not probed.
